scenes.script:
Pallavi says: Agle month tumhara job-interview hai. English kaisi hai tumhari?
Rahul says: Read aur write to sahi kar leta hoon. Par speaking...
Pallavi says: Bolte waqt abhi bhi freeze ho jaate ho?
Rahul says: Haan yaar. Bohot nervousness hoti hai ki log judge karenge.
Pallavi says: Tumhe Supernova AI try karna chahiye. Isme tum actually ek AI teacher se out loud baat karte ho jiska naam Miss Nova hai.
Rahul says: AI teacher?
Pallavi says: Haan! Wo sabse pehle tumhara level check karti hai, phir tumhare liye ek custom plan banati hai.
Rahul says: Awkward lagta hai kya?
Pallavi says: Bilkul nahi. Tum raat ke 2 a.m. pe bhi practice kar sakte ho. Hazaron mistakes karo, wo kabhi tum par hasegi nahi.
Rahul says: Agar main kahin stuck ho gaya to?
Pallavi says: Wo saari logic Hindi mein explain karti hai taaki tum kabhi lost feel na karo.
Rahul says: Wow. Mujhe iski zaroorat hai.
Pallavi says: Scrolling band karo aur din mein bas 15 minutes do. Aaj hi Supernova AI install karo aur bolna start karo! 1 crore se zyada learners ise use kar rahe hain.
